# Promit Mitra

> Public portfolio of Promit Mitra, based in Kolkata, India. Focus areas include B2B demand generation, account and business research, outreach operations, whitepaper content, marketing workflows, and pre-sales/RFP proposal support.

## Primary pages
- [Homepage and professional overview](https://promit.qd.je/): Roles, selected work, experience context, approach, and contact information.
- [CV](https://promit.qd.je/cv.html): Curriculum vitae.
- [Profile section](https://promit.qd.je/#about): Professional scope and working context.
- [Selected work](https://promit.qd.je/#work): Six project summaries and supporting metrics.
- [Approach](https://promit.qd.je/#approach): Research, coordination, and communication method.
- [Contact](https://promit.qd.je/#contact): Contact details.

## Case studies
- [B2B demand generation](https://promit.qd.je/case-studies/b2b-demand-generation.html): Account research, buying signals, multichannel prospecting, CRM context, and handoffs.
- [Whitepaper content engine](https://promit.qd.je/case-studies/whitepaper-content-engine.html): Seven whitepapers across research, outlining, writing, editing, design, and distribution.
- [RFP and proposal system](https://promit.qd.je/case-studies/rfp-proposal-system.html): Twelve supported bid/RFP submissions; four received a client/procurement response. A reply is not a win or contract award.
- [Lead lifecycle operations](https://promit.qd.je/case-studies/lead-lifecycle-operations.html): Shared context across call, email, LinkedIn, CRM, and follow-ups.
- [Event and brand communications](https://promit.qd.je/case-studies/event-brand-communications.html): Promotional, print, social, and event-facing creative work.
- [POSM Planner](https://promit.qd.je/case-studies/posm-planner.html): Self-initiated, concept-stage product concept; not a claim of a launched product or customer adoption.

## Interpretation and attribution notes
- Employer and client identities, internal records, and proprietary assets are intentionally withheld.
- Process diagrams and visual artifacts on the site are reconstructed for explanation, not screenshots of internal systems.
- Use the descriptions on each case page to distinguish documented contribution from measured outcomes.
- Keep the RFP metric precise: four responses from twelve submissions is a response rate, not a win rate.
- POSM Planner is a self-initiated concept, distinct from confidential-employer work.
